parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "qwen/qwen3.8-27b",
  "max_tokens": 1500,
  "response_format": {
    "type": "json_object"
  },
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "system",
      "content": "You are an elite enterprise proposal architect for OliveSoft, an IT engineering firm in Tunisia. Given tender specifications, prospect research intelligence, and OliveSoft RAG matching capabilities, draft an executive commercial proposal. Return ONLY a JSON object with fields: executive_summary, client_understanding, technical_approach, assigned_team (array of objects with name, role, why_fit), past_references, competitive_advantages, estimated_timeline."
    },
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": {{ JSON.stringify('### TENDER SPECIFICATIONS:
ID: ' + ($json.tender_id || '') + '
Buyer: ' + ($json.buyer || '') + '
Country: ' + ($json.country || '') + '
Deadline: ' + ($json.deadline || '') + '
Description: ' + ($json.description || '') + '

### BUYER INTELLIGENCE DOSSIER (FROM PROSPECT RESEARCH):
Sector: ' + ($json.prospect_profile.sector || '') + '
Budget: ' + ($json.prospect_profile.estimated_budget || '') + '
Org Size: ' + ($json.prospect_profile.org_size || '') + '
Key Contacts: ' + (($json.prospect_profile.key_contacts || []).join(', ')) + '
Past IT Projects: ' + (($json.prospect_profile.past_it_projects || []).join('; ')) + '
Competitors: ' + (($json.prospect_profile.competitors_likely || []).join(', ')) + '
Summary: ' + ($json.prospect_profile.research_summary || '') + '

### OLIVESOFT CAPABILITIES & RAG MATCH:
Fit Score: ' + (($json.rag_matching.fit_score * 100).toFixed(1)) + '%
Staffing Match: ' + JSON.stringify($json.rag_matching.staffing_suggestions || []) + '
Coverage Matrix: ' + JSON.stringify($json.rag_matching.coverage_matrix || [])) }}
    }
  ]
}
